university.name: University of East Anglia
university.summary: The University of East Anglia (UEA) is a UK university in Norwich offering undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research programmes through schools including Norwich Business School, UEA Law School, Computing Sciences, Environmental Sciences and Global Development. International pathway programmes are delivered with INTO at the UEA International Study Centre.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor, Student Sponsor: Track Record, Student route (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-07)

courses.title: MSc Artificial Intelligence
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's in the School of Computing Sciences. It opens with Python programming and core AI concepts, then moves to optional AI and programming modules with an applied focus, and ends with a dissertation.
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor's degree, UK 2:2 or above or equivalent, in any discipline. Applicants below this grade with significant relevant work experience may be considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each component; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: Part-time routes of 24 and 36 months also listed. The page recommends learning basic Python before arrival.

courses.title: MSc Business Management
courses.overview: A one-year generalist business master's at Norwich Business School for graduates of any subject. Early study covers people, markets and money, followed by digital technologies, global markets, entrepreneurship, leadership and strategy.
highlights: Digital technologies and AI in decision making
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor's degree, 2:2 or above, in any subject area. Applicants who have already studied business are advised to check the modules for overlap.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each component; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: Optional placement year at an additional GBP 3,500. International Pre-Masters in Business, Economics and Social Sciences listed as a route for applicants below the academic requirement.

courses.title: LLM International Commercial and Business Law
courses.overview: A one-year Master of Laws at UEA Law School covering the legal framework of international trade, commercial transactions and dispute resolution, including treaties, conventions and efforts to harmonise international commercial law.
courses.academic_requirements: UK bachelor's degree, 2:2 or equivalent, in Law or a cognate subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each component; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: The page states the International Commercial Arbitration module is accredited by the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators. Most module titles did not load.

courses.title: MSc Climate Change and Net Zero Solutions
courses.overview: A one-year master's in Environmental Sciences covering climate physics, greenhouse gas emissions and the transformation of energy systems towards net zero, with training in data analysis, GIS and modelling and an independent research dissertation.
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor's degree, 2:2, in a physical or social science subject. Applicants from other backgrounds with relevant climate experience are encouraged to apply.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each component; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.

courses.title: MSc Climate Change and Global Development
courses.overview: A one-year master's in the School of Global Development combining climate science, adaptation, governance and policy with development studies, taught with the Tyndall Centre for Climate Change Research, ending in a research project or work placement.
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor's degree, 2:2 or equivalent, from a recognised higher education institution. Relevant employment experience is also considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each component; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: Study mode not stated on the page; full time assumed from the one-year duration. Placement year option at an additional GBP 3,500.

courses.title: MSc Accounting and Finance
courses.overview: A 12-month research-led master's at Norwich Business School covering international accounting, investments, and corporate finance and governance, with research methods training, optional modules and a final dissertation.
courses.academic_requirements: Bachelor's degree, 2:2, in any subject area, as stated on the course page. The page describes the course as aimed at graduates with an accounting or finance background.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each component; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: Study mode not stated on the page; full time assumed from the 12-month intensive format. Optional placement year at an additional GBP 3,500.

courses.title: BSc Computing Science
courses.overview: A three-year degree in the School of Computing Sciences covering programming, data handling and systems design, with later options in artificial intelligence, cyber security, software development, games and app development, and computer vision.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels ABB including Mathematics, Computing Science, Digital Technology, Chemistry, Physics, Electronics or Economics; or IB 32 points including HL5 in Mathematics, Computing Science, Chemistry, Physics or Economics. GCSE English Language grade 4/C and Mathematics grade 5/B.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in all components; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: Study mode not stated explicitly; full time assumed. INTO UEA International Study Centre preparation programme listed as a progression route.

courses.title: BA International Business Management
courses.overview: A three-year degree at Norwich Business School sharing a common first year in accounting, finance, marketing, management and data skills, followed by strategic analysis, international business and advanced international business cases. Language study is an option.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels ABB; IB 32 points; BTEC Extended Diploma DDM (some BTEC subjects excluded). GCSE English Language and Mathematics grade 4/C.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in all components; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: The page heading states 3 years but one sentence describes a one-year final-year entry course, which appears to be text from the separate final-year entry programme. Study mode not stated explicitly.

courses.title: LLB (Hons) Law
courses.overview: A three-year Bachelor of Laws taught at UEA Law School in Earlham Hall, with compulsory law modules and optional subjects such as Competition Law and Animal Welfare Law.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAB or IB 33 points overall.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in all components; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: Study mode not stated explicitly; full time assumed. Module lists did not load beyond two examples. INTO UEA preparation programme listed as a progression route.

courses.title: BSc Computing Science with a Foundation Year
courses.overview: A four-year route in which an integrated foundation year in computing, programming and essential mathematics precedes the three-year BSc Computing Science, for applicants without the grades or subjects for direct entry.
courses.academic_requirements: International section: A levels CCC or IB 28 points. GCSE English Language and Mathematics grade 4/C.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in all components; test taken within two years of the course start date. Other tests accepted per UEA's English language equivalencies list.
courses.notes: No separate fee is shown for the foundation year; GBP 29,300 is the listed 2027/28 international fee. Study mode not stated explicitly. INTO UEA International Foundation fees and requirements could not be loaded, so this integrated foundation year is used as the foundation route.

scholarships.name: International PG Merit Scholarship A (2026/7)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 (UK 2:2 equivalent) or GBP 7,000 (at least UK 2:1 equivalent) deducted from tuition fees; first year only on two-year programmes
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition reduction for self-funded overseas fee payers from Pakistan, India or Bangladesh starting an on-campus master's or PGCE, with the amount set by the applicant's undergraduate result.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; national of, or domiciled in, Bangladesh, India or Pakistan; on-campus master's or PGCE. Excludes MBBS, integrated master's, PGCert, PGDip, Pre-Masters, Graduate Diploma, online courses and several named MSc and MA programmes. Not available where an outside body or government pays full fees.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline; confirmed shortly after an offer is made.
scholarships.notes: Covers September 2026 and January 2027 starts only. value_amount records the lower tier; GBP 7,000 applies at UK 2:1 equivalent or above. Can be held with International Early Payment Awards only; a higher UEA scholarship replaces it. Terms and conditions section did not load. The September 2027 version had not been published at the time of research.

scholarships.name: 10% Alumni Tuition Fee Discount Scheme
scholarships.summary: A 10% tuition reduction for self-funded UEA graduates, including former study abroad and exchange students, returning for postgraduate taught, postgraduate research or PGCE study.
scholarships.criteria_text: UEA alumni, including study abroad and exchange alumni; self-funded. Excludes MBA, MSc Global Plant Health, MSc Plant Genetics and Crop Improvement, Pre-Masters, integrated master's, PGCert and PGDip. Cannot be combined with other UEA scholarships.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; number of awards unlimited.
scholarships.notes: Listed for January 2026, September 2026 and January 2027 starts; September 2027 not yet listed. Page does not say whether the 10% applies per year or to the whole programme, or whether an offer is required.
